title: Partnership Spotlight: Journey to SOC 2 with Oneleet
summary: How Diligent AI worked with Oneleet to complete SOC 2 Type II and strengthen its security practices.
body_markdown:
At Diligent AI, we build AI agents that help financial institutions automate KYC and AML workflows. Our customers trust us with sensitive information and critical compliance processes. Earning that trust means making security part of every decision about how we build and operate our platform.


In 2026, we strengthened that commitment by completing our SOC 2 Type II audit, building on our ISO 27001 certification with independent evidence that our controls work consistently over time.


## Working with Oneleet


Choosing the right partner mattered. We wanted a team that understood our existing security practices, could work through questions with us, and could provide practical guidance throughout the process. Recommendations from other fintech founders led us to Oneleet, whose direct engagement and hands-on support matched what we were looking for.


## Putting our security to the test


Protecting customer data requires us to keep testing the systems and controls behind our platform. The penetration test, carried out by Oneleet’s in-house security team, was a valuable part of that work.


It gave us an external perspective on our security and actionable findings to strengthen the product further. For our team, its value extended beyond completing the audit: it helped us turn testing into practical improvements.


We now run penetration testing annually, making it a recurring part of how we maintain and strengthen our security practices.


## Looking ahead


SOC 2 Type II gives us independently audited evidence that our controls operate consistently over time. Alongside ISO 27001, it strengthens the assurance we can provide to institutions trusting us with sensitive data and regulated workflows.


As we handle increasingly complex workflows and support more financial institutions, we continue investing in the security behind our platform.


Our work with Oneleet continues as we keep raising the standard for how we protect customer data and evidence our security.
